verdicts.method: Own probe (tools/audit-post8/verification/v-repro-vis/vis-probe.js + vis-analyse.js): motion.js RUN's Play set-up (VIEWS.hybrid 1600x900, Study, Landscape with counters, Field vantage; seek 08:30 or 12:00, Follow on, 1/2x, 8 frames at rest, Play to +3 h, 30 at rest), drawn = the counter's DOM computed opacity >= 0.5, in view = anchor projected by the probe inside the canvas, canvas topmost, not occluded. Run on the audited build f10fe585 and on the pre-Stage-8 build c4793156 (9eb7abb), identical settings; code read at HEAD.
verdicts.evidence: docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-repro-vis/vis-summary.json. Audited 08:30-11:30 (1,560 Play frames): total 67.5% drawn; d'Hautpoul 9.8%, Russian Guard cav 15.7%, Walther 15.9%, French Guard cav 16.2%, Miloradovich 17.3%, Kellermann 36.6%, Nansouty 46.4%; longest gaps Miloradovich 27,667 ms (100.2 clock min from 09:15), rg_cav 17,667, Walther 15,333, guard_cav 13,300, d'Hautpoul 12,667, Kellermann 12,333 ms. 12:00-15:00: 72.3%, d'Hautpoul 11,367 ms, guard_cav 18,033 ms. Default Landscape 09:00-12:00: 89.3%, longest 2,000 ms. App state per cell identical to the area's raw recording in 43,708/43,708 cells (08:30). Pre-Stage-8 c4793156, same runs: 78.4% / 85.6%; d'Hautpoul 5.4%, rg_cav 8.1%, guard_cav 23.8%, Kellermann 38.8% (gap 16,967 ms), Nansouty 44.9%, Walther 39.0%, Miloradovich 33.3% (gap 11,233 ms). Code: app.js:5114 rank, 5126 pri base 3+rank with no event or motion term, 5340 mlMotionSource includes playing, 5474-5482 hold strategy (room at MLS.PASSES=2 passes, every 333 ms). STAGE8_SPEC.md:5308 (121 frames = 4,033 ms window) and 5485-5488 (longer playback left on the final audit checklist).
verdicts.notes: Every number in 'observed' reproduced within 0.4 points / 70 ms but 12:00-15:00 d'Hautpoul (mine 11,367 ms vs 15,300; the longest there is guard_cav 18,033 ms). Not an accepted compromise: section 23.2 leaves longer playback on the final audit checklist. Origin is wrong as stated: the cavalry starvation is inherited (worse before Stage 8 for d'Hautpoul and rg_cav); Stage 8 lowered the totals and tripled Miloradovich's gap. Remedy feasible; needs the owner (decision 240 (a), MOTION.VIS). Closely related to visibility #1 (same mechanism), not a duplicate.

verdicts.method: Own probe (tools/audit-post8/verification/v-repro-vis/ice-probe.js): harness page 1600x900, Watch, aim dok dir [0.55,0.45,0.70] r16 (and r40), clocks 06:30-17:00, factors 4 and 10.33; every visible InstancedMesh instance of every block, its world bottom/top against each mere disc's plane (waterMeshes userData.mere); captures with the ice shown and hidden in the same frame; same probe on pre-Stage-8 c4793156; world.js, app.js, data.js read at HEAD.
verdicts.evidence: Scratch ice-current.json / ice-current-scope.json / ice-pre8.json (logs beside them); captures docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-repro-vis/current-dok-1640-r16.jpg vs -r16-noice.jpg (men cut at the thigh, legs whole without the ice) and -r40.jpg vs -r40-noice.jpg (Buxhowden's tents sunk to their tips, horses' legs cut). Satschan disc y -4.14, bed below it 69.2%, max 0.875; Menitz 77.5%, max 1.143. 16:40 at 4x: Dokhturov 350 of 378 instances below the ice, Kienmayer 289/328, Buxhowden 28/40 (its 4 tents up to 59% of their height under), Friant 24/99, Legrand 2/13; at 10.33x up to 2.338 units. verdicts.notes: Area numbers reproduced (69%/0.874, 78%/1.142). Minor corrections: the ice's live opacity on the landscape is 0.94 (app.js:4838), 0.96 only in the declaration; the '62% of a man' divides the depth by the kit's head top 1.415 (app.js:890), which my per-mesh fractions do not confirm exactly, though the captures show men cut at the thigh. Scope is wider than the ponds phase: blocks overlapping the disc are sunk at 06:30 (Kienmayer 136 of 222), 12:00 (Kienmayer 64/95, Dokhturov 114/172) and 14:00 (Kienmayer 100/154, Dokhturov 35/92); see extra issue. S2/P2 kept: the battle's best-known moment, visible from r40, against the disputed drowning story (data.js:749). Remedy feasible, presentation only; seating must stay consistent with groundYFast (the gait's contact check) and the height guard.
